subject.title: fix: confine Islo redirects to configured origin

question: Should Crabbox enforce fail-closed same-origin redirect confinement for all Islo custom endpoints, or require a trusted-origin opt-in for deployments that intentionally redirect elsewhere?
rationale: The documented credential-destination boundary supports the PR, but merging it can intentionally break existing custom Islo endpoint routing patterns, so the compatibility/security policy should be maintainer-owned.

options.title: Land fail-closed after sanitization
options.body: Fix the redirect error leak, keep same-origin redirects working, and accept that configured Islo endpoints must not redirect credential-bearing requests outside their effective origin.

options.title: Require trusted redirect origins
options.body: Add an explicit trusted-user allowlist or migration path if supported Islo deployments legitimately depend on cross-origin redirects.

options.title: Pause for provider semantics
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers confirm whether Islo service routing permits enforcing this boundary for every configured endpoint.

recommendation.title: Land fail-closed after sanitization
recommendation.body: Fix the redirect error leak, keep same-origin redirects working, and accept that configured Islo endpoints must not redirect credential-bearing requests outside their effective origin.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Islo provider introduction, the current client snapshot, and the security-boundary docs.
